mentions.name: Petra
mentions.description: A command-line tool for Obsidian that interacts with the vault through the API served by the Petra-Bridge plugin, letting a Claude Skill create markdown files in the vault and read from them when the model needs context.
mentions.problem: AI assistants like Claude clutter the author's files with random markdown files, so the author wanted a clean way for Claude to write into and read from their Obsidian vault.
mentions.source_excerpt: Petra (Obsidian CLI) and Petra-Bridge (Obsidian API for the CLI tool integration).
